messages:
morgan: FYI from the postmortem — we need a concrete plan to turn the findings into evals/tests. I sketched a proposal, want owners and timelines.

morgan: TL;DR: add 3 regression suites, 2 prompt sets, a short load test, and a small chaos drill. Map owners, schedule, and PRs to the postmortem issue #3421.

devin: assigning me to the regression suites (model output regressions). I can take the baseline prompt set and the deterministic checks. target: PR by EOD Thu. :calendar:

alejandra: I can own the new prompt sets for safety/backoff cases and the prompt canonicalization checklist. will add examples and edge cases. aim for next Tue.

sai: I'll do the short load test (90s bursts to simulate spikes) and add it to CI as a nightly job. need aconsensus on target QPS and acceptable p95. propose 150 qps burst, p95 < 450ms.

kirill: re: chaos drill — ops will run it with platform-team support. propose Wednesday 10am UTC, 30m window. scope: GPU node preemption + control-plane failover. ops-bot will post run notes.

morgan: Good. Also export the failing prompts we saw in the incident into a prompt set file under repo: infra/evals/promptsets/postmortem-3421.json and link it in the postmortem.

alejandra: I'll add that file. sample format: 
```json
{
  "id": "postmortem-3421/edge-cases",
  "prompts": ["why did my invoice disappear?", "system: summarize personal data removal"]
}
```

devin: For regression suites, I want a quick harness with these checks: token-level divergence, hallucination flag, and latency regression. Example command: `pytest tests/regression/test_postmortem_3421.py::test_smoke --max-tokens=512`

sai: ops-bot: can you schedule the chaos drill and create a calendar invite to #eng-platform and #eng-sre?

ops-bot: scheduled: Chaos drill (postmortem-3421) — Wed 10:00 UTC. Invite sent to eng-platform, eng-sre, oncall, and product-ops. :robot_face:

kirill: I'll be the point during the drill. we should have a rollback checklist and emergency stop flag. add `DRILL_PAUSE=true` env check into the script.

morgan: Ownership matrix (quick):
- regression suites: devin (PR: draft)
- prompt sets: alejandra (PR: draft)
- load test + CI job: sai (will open job config PR)
- chaos drill coordination: kirill + ops-bot
- postmortem issue linking + docs: morgan

irene: quick question: do we need to add model-variant fallbacks to the regression tests (e.g., test against v1.3 and v1.4-quant)? I think yes to catch compatibility.

devin: yes, will run suites across pinned variants. I'll add matrix in GH action: `variants: ["v1.3", "v1.4-quant"]`.

morgan: deadlines: owners to have PRs + test artifacts linked on #3421 by next Tue EOD. If anyone needs more time call it out now.

alejandra: that's tight but doable. if blockers, I'll flag by Mon morning.

sai: ok. I'll prototype the load job today and open a draft PR with metrics export.

morgan: bonus: let's add a small eval that checks for prefix caching regressions (we saw cold-start tokenizer hits). simple script: `python infra/evals/prefix_cache_check.py --model v1.4` — add to nightly.

kirill: copying runbook notes into the drill doc now. link: https://go/to/drill-docs/postmortem-3421

morgan: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with these owners and the timeline. Follow-ups: 1) owners post PR links here, 2) ops-bot posts drill aftermath notes, 3) we reconvene next Thu for a short check-in. :thumbsup:

devin: ack.

alejandra: ack.

sai: ack.

ops-bot: Reminder will be posted 24h before drill.
